_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Date_Polling/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Date_Polling/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Written 2026-10-12 from the code. Polls live on our servers so everyone with the link can reach them: the poll (title, dates and times, time zone, location, settings) and every answer (the name typed and the choices) are Other user-generated content and Name, required to create or answer a poll. The host's poll is owned by an account id (Universal ID, an emailed-code account, or an anonymous host session behind a private admin link), so User IDs are required for hosts. Email is optional: a host's address for alerts/booking emails, a respondent's address for the confirmed time, a booking guest's address, and the Universal ID sign-in email. A host's logo upload is Photos (optional). Connecting Google/Microsoft calendar (optional, host only) lets the server read busy times (Microsoft also event titles) and add a confirmed time: Calendar events. Sign-in (@unisim/sdk) is optional (password, emailed code, or Apple/Google/Microsoft). App interactions, optional: one session.opened event per launch while signed in with a company (<UsageTracker />), for Analytics. The suite user count (@unisim/sdk presence) is OFF in the phone app (src/main.tsx presence false when Capacitor is native), so no Device or other IDs. Add to calendar builds the event on the device. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
